txt: Mack 'The Torso' Torson is finger-fucking his fist, laughing hoarsely and apparently telling some dirty story to his partner, Chester McLaine, near the entrance.
Suddenly he interjects: "Yeah, Mullen was fucked alright. Sounded fucking drunk to me."
The man is laughing too hard to form coherent sentences. The only words you can make out are 'lost' and 'badge'.
Torson chews thoughtfully at his sausage for some time. "Hey, Chester, I've been wondering... do you think anybody's ever gone full hobocop?"
Torson chews thoughtfully at his sausage for some time. "Hey, Chester, speaking of... do you think Harry ever solved his money situation, or do you think he's gone full hobocop?"
"*What* the fuck does he want now? More attention? A fiver? A parade?"
"A very fuckin' dangerous case, ain't that right, Chester? They almost got you that time."
"Ask him!"
"Ask him..." The speaker gasps for air. "Ask him if he lost his *gun* too!" The room roars with laughter.
"But of course, it says Dick Mullen -- High General of the Revacholian Cavalry Force."
"Come on, Chester, tell the story again." A bald man turns toward a lean man and pats him on the back.
"Dear god, he lost his gun!!! Oh my... I can't... He..." The man succumbs to laughter again.
"He lost his *what* now?!"
"Hetero -- sexual. Life -- partners."
"Hetero... sexual. Life... partners."
"In pursuit of his..." The man is fighting back tears.
"Is there something wrong?"
"It's not fucking cryo-actilate... it's super glue, doc."
"Oh I... I can't... Fuuuuuck, he lost his... Ask him if he still has his wiener!"
"Oh god, I..." The man is fighting back tears.
"Okay, tell him..."
"Oldboy,  is fucky *still* at it?! What the hell does he want now?"
"Shut up, Chester, this isn't funny. This is my mom we're talking about!"
"Tell him to apologize right now!"
"Tell him to sober up and blow himself."

"The *fuck* it is," the bald man replies. "And these guys haven't heard it." He motions to the civilian sitting in the back seat. "You see, Chester here," he pokes his finger at the lean man. "Chester *faked his own death* once!"
"The prick ate momma's vanilla waffles at the captain's birthday party! Some nerve he's got..."
"What's going on?"
"What's he saying? Share with the class!"
"What, like you've never reheated leftovers in the break room?" He skewers the greasy sausage with a small fork and removes it to a limp paper plate.
"What, you mean the one Vic yoinked off..."
"Where's your homo, homey?"
"Why, did he find it?" The room at the other end of the line erupts in volcanic laughter.
"With that animal? Never again, man. What, is he still down there, in... you know, south of the interchange? The... what was it?"
"Wonder if Vic's found his hetero-sexual life partner yet." The man in the fishnet wifebeater looks over at Chester McLaine.
"Wonder if Vic's found his long lost boyfriend yet." He looks over at Chester McLaine and breaks into a laugh at his own joke. The rain falls outside.
"Yeah, Mullen was fucked alright. Sounded fucking drunk to me."
